digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the 14-field binding payload object (key-sorted, explicit nulls, strict number domain)

vectors.description: Baseline write plan (medium / L2 / reversible_write) with verification and rollback plans.
number 0
number -0 (canonicalizes to 0; the plan JSON text carries the literal -0)
number 1
number -1
number 1.5
large safe integer 123456789
Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
ASCII string
CJK string
emoji string
combining sequence e + U+0301 (not normalized)
precomposed U+00E9 (not normalized; digest differs from the combining form)
verification_plan and rollback_plan are explicit JSON null (never omitted).
expires_at absent on the plan encodes as explicit JSON null in the binding payload.
